name: cinemacc-subtitle
description: An auditable agent skill for finding, repairing, translating, validating, and packaging SRT subtitles.

interface.shortDescription: Find, refine, translate, and package SRT subtitles
interface.longDescription: Find or use a source track, verify it, repair and translate it, then deliver standalone SRTs or a CinemaCC import bundle without silently changing cue timing.
defaultPrompt: Find an eligible English SRT for this title, refine it, translate it, and package the result for CinemaCC.
Repair and translate this SRT into natural Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
Inspect this subtitle file and report structural, textual, coverage, and timing risks.
Package this checked source and translation as a CinemaCC import bundle.
